tagline: Link Figma designs to Trello product cards and automate the design review workflow
metaTitle: Trello + Figma Integration: Figma Files on Trello Cards
metaDescription: Attach Figma files to Trello cards and move cards when designs are ready for review. GAIA keeps design and board aligned. See the setup steps.
intro:
Product teams managing work in Trello and design teams working in Figma face a recurring handoff problem. Designers share links in Slack or email, but those links never make it onto the card. Product managers check the board to see if designs are ready but find no file attached and no status update. The result is a fragmented review process that delays development and creates confusion about which design version is current.

GAIA connects the two so design deliverables are always attached to the right card and design status changes automatically advance cards through the workflow. When a file is updated for a project, GAIA attaches it to the linked card. When designs are approved in Figma, GAIA moves the card to the next stage. Teams stay in their preferred tools while the handoff happens automatically.

This integration is built for product and design teams that want to eliminate manual status updates and ensure design assets are always discoverable from the project board.

useCases.title: Attach Figma files to Trello product cards
useCases.description: When a file is created or updated for a feature, GAIA automatically attaches the link to the corresponding card, ensuring the latest design is always accessible from the product board.

useCases.title: Move cards when designs are ready for review
useCases.description: When a file status changes to Ready for Review, GAIA moves the linked card to the Design Review list and notifies the reviewer, starting the feedback loop without a manual card update.

useCases.title: Advance cards on design approval
useCases.description: When a design is approved in a comment or status field, GAIA moves the card to the Development Ready list and notifies the engineering assignee, making the design-to-dev handoff instant and traceable.

useCases.title: Flag revision requests on cards
useCases.description: When a reviewer leaves revision feedback, GAIA posts a comment on the linked card summarizing the requested changes and moves the card back to In Design, keeping status accurate.

useCases.title: Design sprint tracking
useCases.description: GAIA monitors all files linked to a sprint board and generates a weekly design progress report showing how many cards are in design, in review, approved, and delivered.

howItWorks.step: Connect Trello and Figma to GAIA
howItWorks.description: Authorize GAIA to access your Trello boards and your Figma account. Map projects to boards and configure how design status changes map to list movements.
GAIA can auto-link files to cards by matching names, or you can explicitly link a file to a card on first reference. GAIA maintains the association going forward.

howItWorks.step: GAIA manages the design review workflow
howItWorks.description: As file statuses change, GAIA moves cards, attaches updated file links, and notifies the relevant team members, keeping the design review process on track automatically.

faqs.question: Can GAIA attach specific Figma frames to cards rather than the whole file?
faqs.answer: Yes. You can configure GAIA to attach specific frame links so reviewers navigate directly to the relevant design component rather than searching through a large file.

faqs.question: What happens when a design is revised after being approved?
faqs.answer: GAIA detects the post-approval edit and can reopen the review card or notify the product manager, ensuring revised designs get proper sign-off before development proceeds.

faqs.question: Does GAIA work with branching for design review?
faqs.answer: Yes. GAIA can track branches and attach branch links to cards during review, then update the card to the main file link when the branch is merged after approval.
